@@ -0,0 +1,153 @@
+import builtins
+import os
+import stat
+
+import pytest
+
+import dotenv.main as main
+
+
+def edit(path, operation, **kwargs):
+    if operation == "set":
+        return main.set_key(path, "REMOVE", "new", quote_mode="never", **kwargs)
+    return main.unset_key(path, "REMOVE", **kwargs)
+
+
+def record_sources(monkeypatch, path):
+    sources = []
+    real_open = builtins.open
+
+    def tracked_open(file, *args, **kwargs):
+        stream = real_open(file, *args, **kwargs)
+        if os.fspath(file) == os.fspath(path):
+            sources.append(stream)
+        return stream
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", tracked_open)
+    return sources
+
+
+class FaultyOutput:
+    def __init__(self, wrapped, phase, failure):
+        self.wrapped = wrapped
+        self.phase = phase
+        self.failure = failure
+
+    def __getattr__(self, name):
+        return getattr(self.wrapped, name)
+
+    def __enter__(self):
+        return self
+
+    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, traceback):
+        self.close()
+
+    def write(self, value):
+        if self.phase == "write":
+            raise self.failure
+        return self.wrapped.write(value)
+
+    def flush(self):
+        self.wrapped.flush()
+        if self.phase == "flush":
+            raise self.failure
+
+    def close(self):
+        try:
+            if self.phase == "flush":
+                self.flush()
+        finally:
+            self.wrapped.close()
+        if self.phase == "close":
+            raise self.failure
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("operation", ["set", "unset"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("phase", ["flush", "close", "write"])
+def test_edit_failure_is_atomic_and_cleans_up(tmp_path, monkeypatch, operation, phase):
+    path = tmp_path / ".env"
+    original = b"KEEP=one\nREMOVE=old\n"
+    path.write_bytes(original)
+    sources = record_sources(monkeypatch, path)
+    failure = OSError("injected output failure")
+    factory = main.tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile
+    outputs = []
+    replacements = []
+
+    def faulty_factory(*args, **kwargs):
+        output = FaultyOutput(factory(*args, **kwargs), phase, failure)
+        outputs.append(output)
+        return output
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(main.tempfile, "NamedTemporaryFile", faulty_factory)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(main.os, "replace", lambda *args, **kwargs: replacements.append(args))
+    with pytest.raises(OSError) as caught:
+        edit(path, operation)
+
+    assert caught.value is failure
+    assert path.read_bytes() == original
+    assert replacements == []
+    assert outputs and all(output.wrapped.closed for output in outputs)
+    assert sources and all(source.closed for source in sources)
+    assert list(tmp_path.glob(".tmp_*")) == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("operation", ["set", "unset"])
+def test_creation_failure_closes_source(tmp_path, monkeypatch, operation):
+    path = tmp_path / ".env"
+    original = b"KEEP=one\nREMOVE=old\n"
+    path.write_bytes(original)
+    sources = record_sources(monkeypatch, path)
+    failure = OSError("injected temporary-file creation failure")
+    replacements = []
+
+    def unavailable(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise failure
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(main.tempfile, "NamedTemporaryFile", unavailable)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(main.os, "replace", lambda *args, **kwargs: replacements.append(args))
+    with pytest.raises(OSError) as caught:
+        edit(path, operation)
+
+    assert caught.value is failure
+    assert path.read_bytes() == original
+    assert replacements == []
+    assert sources and all(source.closed for source in sources)
+    assert list(tmp_path.glob(".tmp_*")) == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("operation", ["set", "unset"])
+def test_success_preserves_mode(tmp_path, operation):
+    path = tmp_path / ".env"
+    path.write_text("KEEP=one\nREMOVE=old\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    path.chmod(0o640)
+    result = edit(path, operation)
+    expected = "KEEP=one\nREMOVE=new\n" if operation == "set" else "KEEP=one\n"
+    assert result[0] is True
+    assert path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == expected
+    if os.name != "nt":
+        assert stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode) == 0o640
+    assert list(tmp_path.glob(".tmp_*")) == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(os.name == "nt", reason="Requires POSIX symlinks")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("operation", ["set", "unset"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("follow", [False, True])
+def test_success_preserves_symlink_policy(tmp_path, operation, follow):
+    target = tmp_path / "target.env"
+    original = "KEEP=one\nREMOVE=old\n"
+    target.write_text(original, encoding="utf-8")
+    target.chmod(0o640)
+    path = tmp_path / ".env"
+    path.symlink_to(target)
+
+    edit(path, operation, follow_symlinks=follow)
+    expected = "KEEP=one\nREMOVE=new\n" if operation == "set" else "KEEP=one\n"
+    assert path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == expected
+    assert path.is_symlink() is follow
+    if follow:
+        assert target.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == expected
+        assert stat.S_IMODE(target.stat().st_mode) == 0o640
+    else:
+        assert target.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == original
+    assert list(tmp_path.glob(".tmp_*")) == []
